blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified at Ethereum block 26082912 (2026-09-29T11:46:23Z). The sole contracts[] deployment, 0x57ab1e0003f623289cd798b1824be09a793e4bec, exactly matches the verified non-proxy Stablecoin runtime bytecode; its EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots are zero. The source has no non-1967 delegation or upgrade path, transfer override, holder blacklist, global transfer pause or arbitrary-holder burn. Owner is permanently Resupply Core 0xc07e000044f95655c11fda4cd37f70a94d7e0a7d. Owner/operators can mint; burn(from,amount) requires allowance when caller differs from from. Registry 0x10101010e0c3171d894b71b3400668af311e7d94 is an active mint operator. Core executes calls for its voter or explicitly authorized target/selector operators; voter 0x11111111063874ce8dc6232cb5c1c849359476e6 has executionDelay 86400 seconds and votingPeriod 604800 seconds. These powers cannot replace token code or bypass holder burn allowances. LayerZero OFT peer, delegate and message-inspector configuration controls cross-chain sends, not ordinary ERC-20 transfers; msgInspector is zero. No additional bridged deployment is listed in contracts[]. At the same block, Registry.getAllPairAddresses() returned 22 pairs, 21 with positive totalCollateral. For every pair, underlying() matched collateral().asset(); converting getPairAccounting().totalCollateral through collateral.convertToAssets() yielded 52,119,508.794017 crvUSD and 668,390.539130 frxUSD underlying units, totaling 52,787,899.333147 at the protocol's dollar-par accounting basis. Composition is 98.733819% crvusd-curve (reviewed inherited) and 1.266181% frxusd-frax (reviewed true), giving 100% exposed reserves, strictly above 50%. These are reserve-slice upstreams, not parent identities. The previous no-parent rationale contradicted the public exposure contract: reserve-based Upstream needs no parent asset and does not assert direct seizure of reUSD balances. The inherited classification follows the reserve-exposure precedent of dai-makerdao and the stored crvusd-curve status; crvusd-curve's own prose denying inherited treatment is inconsistent with its stored status and is not relied on as methodology.

oracleRisk.summary: Resupply lending pairs value ERC-4626 collateral from its share-to-underlying conversion while treating the crvUSD or frxUSD underlying as one dollar, so liquidations use an internal vault-rate path rather than market-price feeds.

branchApplicability.rationale: reUSD is borrowed through separately registered Curve Lend and Fraxlend collateral pairs. At Ethereum block 25530458, 18 registered pairs pointed to the same BasicVaultOracle and shared ResupplyPair, LiquidationHandler, and InsurancePool logic; the wstUSR pair had a zero oracle and zero borrow limit. The configured pairs are therefore represented as one grouped common-engine branch and wstUSR is excluded.

branches.label: Registered Curve Lend and Fraxlend vault pairs
branches.summary: Enabled Resupply pairs use the common BasicVaultOracle to convert lending-vault shares to crvUSD or frxUSD units and apply the pair's configured maximum LTV without an external USD market-price feed.
collateralAssets: Registered Curve Lend and Fraxlend ERC-4626 vault shares backed by crvUSD or frxUSD

feeds.path: ERC-4626 convertToAssets share rate, with crvUSD/frxUSD treated as $1 -> inverted pair exchange rate -> borrower LTV

branches.fallbackBehavior: The pair calls BasicVaultOracle on every exchange-rate update and stores a new rate only when the result changes. A reverting vault conversion or out-of-bounds share price reverts the operation; the liquidation path does not fall back to the stored exchange rate or an external stablecoin market feed.

collateralParameters.asset: Registered Curve Lend and Fraxlend ERC-4626 vault shares backed by crvUSD or frxUSD
collateralParameters.note: The deployment default is 95% maximum LTV, but governance can configure maximum LTV, borrow limit, and liquidation fee per registered pair.

branches.liquidationMechanism: When current debt divided by vault-share value exceeds the pair maximum LTV, any caller may route a liquidation through LiquidationHandler. The pair closes the borrower's full debt, transfers collateral shares to the handler, and pays the configured liquidation incentive from recovered collateral where available.
branches.backstop: LiquidationHandler redeems recovered vault shares into the Resupply InsurancePool and burns InsurancePool reUSD assets up to both recovered value and the pool's burnable balance.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Any portion not covered by redeemable collateral or the InsurancePool remains recorded as debtByCollateral. Governance can later process collateral and clear that debt when the InsurancePool can burn it; the guardian pause sets pair borrowing capacity to zero but does not define a global settlement or alternate oracle.
